verdict.rationale: Open WebUI documents running one agent per workspace, supervised in parallel from one tab, and exposes each workspace as its own OpenAI-compatible model. Custom agents built as Functions appear as selectable models in the sidebar. Channels let multiple models take part in shared timelines, so distinct agents and some conversation-level assignment exist, but per-agent prompt configuration and explicit routing of channels to specific agents are not documented. missing for 10: documented per-agent system prompt configuration, explicit routing rules mapping conversations/channels to specific agents, independent hands-on corroboration

support.subject: As a power user, I can run multiple distinct agents with their own prompts, models, and workspaces, and route conversations or channels to each

citations.quote: one worktree per task, one workspace per worktree, one agent per workspace, all supervised from a single browser tab.
The gateway exposes each of your workspaces as an OpenAI-compatible model, so any OpenAI-style client can run agent tasks in a real workspace.
Adds a custom model or agent | Appears as a selectable model in the chat sidebar
Channels let multiple users and multiple models interact in a single timeline.
